publisher: New York State Office of Children and Family Services Division of Child Care Services

official_sources.evidence: OCFS publishes licensed and registered child-care program data for public research and provider selection.
NY Open Data exposes the Child Care Regulated Programs API as a supported SODA2 program-level interface.
The catalog describes daily posting, current program information, two years of violation history, statewide program-level coverage, and explicit exclusion of NYC day care centers.
OCFS search distinguishes family, group-family, center, school-age, small-center, and legally exempt group programs and routes NYC center-based programs to NYC Health.

scope.warning: OCFS program presence, open status, license or registration, enforcement, legally exempt enrollment, NYC Health regulation, and current operation are separate assertions.

temporal.limitation: Daily catalog currency does not prove continuous operation; NYC center-based programs require a separately governed NYC Health source before statewide center coverage can be claimed.

next_action: Validate the OCFS SODA schema and pagination contract without acquiring provider rows, identify an authorized NYC Health center-level source, and reconcile regulator, cohort, status, privacy, temporal meaning, reuse, and conservation before admission.
